verdict.rationale: PayPal documents its own no-code hosted payment surfaces: shareable Payment Links, a secure PayPal payment page for invoices "without building their own payment flow," and a PayPal button that lets customers pay with their linked funding sources. Conversion features such as Fastlane autofill and access to 400M users are also claimed. However, the evidence never explicitly describes redirecting customers from your site to a PayPal-hosted checkout session as a general checkout flow. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a redirect-to-hosted-checkout flow for site orders, evidence of conversion optimization on the hosted page itself, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can redirect customers to a vendor-hosted, conversion-optimized checkout page without building my own payment UI

citations.quote: Swiftly create a Payment Link to share on your website, via email, on social media, or through text. No coding skills required.
get paid through a secure PayPal payment page, without building their own payment flow
Customers can select the PayPal button on your site and pay with any funding source linked to their PayPal account.
Automatically recognize guest shoppers with Fastlane by PayPal. Next time they shop, we’ll autofill their checkout credentials.
